general.name: 日常生活
general.description: 从日常词语开始，打好语言基础。

cet4.name: 大学英语四级
cet4.description: 四级起步词汇 · 校园、工作与日常表达
entries: She has the ability to solve difficult problems.
Regular practice helps you achieve your goals.
经常练习有助于实现目标。
A small class has one clear advantage.
小班教学有一个明显优势。
How do I apply for the course?
All students can attend the workshop.
所有学生都可以参加研讨课。
One benefit of walking is better sleep.
步行的一个好处是改善睡眠。
Compare the prices before you buy.
Please consider the needs of local residents.
请考虑当地居民的需求。
Children develop new skills through play.
孩子们通过玩耍发展新技能。
A quiet environment helps me concentrate.
安静的环境有助于我集中注意力。
This job gave me valuable experience.
这份工作给了我宝贵的经验。
How can we improve public transport?
我们怎样改善公共交通？
The number of students will increase next year.
Travel can broaden our knowledge of the world.
旅行能拓宽我们对世界的认识。
This is an opportunity to learn something new.
这是学习新事物的机会。
I need time to prepare for the interview.
The library can provide a quiet study space.
图书馆可以提供安静的学习空间。
有些任务需要仔细规划。
Education plays an important role in society.
教育在社会中发挥着重要作用。
I suggest taking the earlier train.
我建议乘坐更早的火车。

cet6.name: 大学英语六级
cet6.description: 六级起步词汇 · 抽象概念与学术表达
entries: The hall can accommodate two hundred people.
这个大厅可容纳两百人。
小额储蓄会随着时间积累。
Many researchers advocate a balanced approach.
许多研究人员提倡均衡的方法。
The company agreed to compensate the passengers.
We need a comprehensive review of the evidence.
我们需要全面审查证据。
Limited funding can constrain scientific research.
有限的资金可能限制科学研究。
这家博物馆展示当代艺术。
Air quality may deteriorate during a heatwave.
热浪期间空气质量可能恶化。
These measures could diminish the risk.
这些措施可以降低风险。
这个理论需要实证支持。
这个提案在财务上可行吗？
A discount can be an incentive to buy.
折扣可以成为购买的激励。
The project will integrate several data sources.
这个项目将整合几个数据源。
Travel gave her a new perspective on life.
旅行让她对生活有了新的视角。
城市需要可持续的交通系统。
We must understand the underlying causes.
我们必须了解潜在的原因。

ielts.name: 雅思 IELTS
ielts.description: 雅思起步词汇 · 教育、环境与社会话题
entries: Protecting biodiversity is essential for healthy ecosystems.
保护生物多样性对健康的生态系统至关重要。
The curriculum includes science and the arts.
课程体系包括科学和艺术。
The report measures carbon emission levels.
这份报告测量碳排放水平。
Better infrastructure can connect rural communities.
更好的基础设施可以连接农村社区。
Migration can change the population of a city.
迁移可能改变城市的人口。
Wind is a renewable source of energy.
Rapid urbanisation puts pressure on housing.
快速城市化给住房带来压力。
该公园支持野生动物保护。
We should reduce our water consumption.
Innovation can improve access to education.
创新可以改善教育机会。
Public libraries can help improve literacy.
公共图书馆有助于提高读写能力。
The forest is a natural habitat for many birds.
森林是许多鸟类的自然栖息地。
The population is expected to grow steadily.
Recycling reduces the amount of household waste.
回收利用减少了生活垃圾的数量。
Clean water is a valuable resource.
清洁的水是一种宝贵的资源。
Public transportation can reduce traffic congestion.
公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵。
High tuition fees may discourage some students.
高昂的学费可能使一些学生却步。
这项调查研究青年失业问题。
The policy aims to improve social welfare.
该政策旨在改善社会福利。
An ageing workforce creates new challenges.
劳动力老龄化带来新的挑战。

travel.name: 出国旅游
travel.description: 旅行起步 · 问路、交通与日常求助
entries: Our adventure begins in a small coastal town.
我们的冒险从一座海滨小镇开始。
Please keep your passport in a safe place.
请把护照放在安全的地方。
Do I need a visa for this trip?
这次旅行我需要签证吗？
Could you send me the itinerary?
我们的最终目的地是爱丁堡。
我可以在哪里兑换货币？
I would like to exchange some cash.
Is the station in this direction?
What time does the museum open?
Can I buy a ticket here?
I have a reservation for two people.
我预订了两个人的位子。
Is there a restaurant near the station?
Could I have a receipt, please?
Who should I call in an emergency?
遇到紧急情况我应该给谁打电话？
Which subway line goes to the airport?
哪条地铁线路通往机场？
I bought a small souvenir for my sister.
我给妹妹买了一个小纪念品。
Does my travel insurance cover this?
我的旅行保险涵盖这一项吗？
Our guide will meet us at the entrance.
导游会在入口处与我们见面。
The entrance is on your left.

hotel.name: 酒店入住
hotel.description: 入住起步 · 前台、房间与酒店服务
entries: Please leave your key at reception.
What time can we check in?
我们几点可以办理入住？
We would like to check out early.
Could you check my booking, please?
请帮我核实一下预订好吗？
I need a single room for tonight.
今晚我需要一个单人间。
Is breakfast included in the price?
When will I get my deposit back?
我什么时候能拿回押金？
My key card is not working.
The lift is next to the stairs.
Which floor is the restaurant on?
Could I have an extra towel?
可以再给我一条毛巾吗？
Could you send housekeeping to my room?
可以请客房清洁人员来我的房间吗？
Can I leave my luggage here until noon?
我能把行李寄存在这里到中午吗？
The air conditioning is too cold.
Could I have a wake-up call at six?
可以在六点给我提供叫醒服务吗？
Do you offer a laundry service?
Could I have a quiet room?
可以给我一个安静的房间吗？
Could you explain this item on my bill?
可以解释一下账单上的这一项吗？

airport.name: 机场对话
airport.description: 机场起步 · 值机、安检与登机
entries: May I see your boarding pass?
我可以看一下你的登机牌吗？
Which gate does this flight leave from?
这个航班从哪个登机口出发？
How do I get to Terminal Two?
Please remove your jacket at security.
Do I need to declare this at customs?
我需要在海关申报这个吗？
Where can I collect my baggage?
我可以在哪里领取行李？
Is this bag allowed as a carry-on?
这个包可以作为随身行李吗？
Could I have an aisle seat?
可以给我一个靠过道的座位吗？
I would prefer a window seat.
我更想要一个靠窗座位。
Is this the flight to London?
这是飞往伦敦的航班吗？
Does this bag contain any liquid?
Please have your passport ready for immigration.
请准备好护照接受入境检查。
Is there a shuttle to the other terminal?
有去另一个航站楼的接驳车吗？

en: This book is easy to read.
I will be home before dinner.
The moon is above the lake.
I learn something new every day.
我们的狗喜欢长时间散步。
The school is near my house.
There is a flower on the table.
Do you have time for a walk?
I want to see the world.
zh: I would like a glass of water.
The school is not far from here.
I want to see the world.
ja: こんにちは、お元気ですか。
手伝ってくれてありがとう。
この本はおもしろいです。
この都市は大きいです。
fr: Ma maison est près du parc.
es: Mi casa está cerca del parque.

home.translation: 没有什么地方比得上家。
home.source: 《绿野仙踪》(1939) · AFI 电影名句

apply.source: IELTS 官方听力样题 · Sentence Completion · Paul

ability.text: And finally under column three, they identified an ability to juggle several roles – what we might call their capacity for multi-tasking.
ability.translation: 最后在第三栏，他们指出了兼顾多种角色的能力，也就是我们所说的多任务处理能力。
ability.source: IELTS 官方听力样题 · Table Completion · 末段

thankYou.text: Good afternoon everybody and thank you for giving me your time today.
thankYou.translation: 大家下午好，感谢你们今天抽出时间。
thankYou.source: IELTS 官方听力样题 · Short Answer Questions · 首句

school.text: Please be as quiet as possible and do not take photographs, as school is in session.
school.translation: 请尽量保持安静，不要拍照，因为学校正在上课。
school.source: IELTS 官方听力样题 · Plan/Map/Diagram Labelling · 末句
